status_note: Written from general knowledge of the public site. NOT yet checked against the live pages from our server. Patterns are starting points; the drift check marks what it could verify.
search_flow: 1. Resolve the user's area (their own saved place or city); ask if unknown. Never guess a city.
2. Web search: '<dish> <area> swiggy' (OpenAI web_search via the WEB_LOOKUP port). Keep only results on swiggy.com.
3. For each cited swiggy.com page read: restaurant name, rating, cost for two or dish price, delivery time, offer text as printed.
4. Apply the user's price cap only where a dish price is actually shown; otherwise label the price 'not shown'.
5. Return options with the cited page as source and a deep link; if no restaurant page was cited, return the dish search link.
city_slug_rule: lower-case, spaces to hyphens; unknown -> use the search link and say the location must be set in the app

locations.restaurant_name: heading of the restaurant page; card title in search results
locations.rating: star badge with rating and count on the card (e.g. '4.2')
locations.price: listing cards show 'Rs <n> for two'; dish prices are on the menu page loaded by script
locations.delivery_time: minutes shown on the card (e.g. '25-30 mins'); exact only after the address is set
locations.offers: offer banner on the card/header (e.g. 'Items at Rs 99'); coupons at checkout
locations.delivery_fee: only visible at cart after an address is chosen

login_checkout.login: phone number + OTP (typed by the user in their own app; Friday never asks for it here)
login_checkout.location: a delivery location must be set (cookie or account) before the search shows results
login_checkout.stop_rule: Friday stops BEFORE the payment page. The user opens the deep link and pays in their own app. No payment is ever submitted by Friday.

quirks: The search page needs a location; without one it may show a location prompt instead of results.
Menu item prices are script-loaded; web search snippets often show 'for two' costs instead of dish prices.
Prices, offers and delivery times differ by outlet, address and time; results can be stale.
Taxes, packing and delivery fees are added at checkout.

anti_bot.behaviour: Public pages may answer 403/429 or show a bot challenge to non-browser clients, especially from cloud data-centre addresses.
anti_bot.our_response: Never solve or bypass a challenge. Probes and lookups report 'unverified' and keep the last good knowledge version.
